svg.title: Comparison of 2 by 2, 4 by 4 and 8 by 8 one-level lattices
svg.desc: The three grids contain 4, 16 and 64 horizontal cells, respectively, at identical module pitch and projection. Thin vertical references describe one 20-foot registration interval.

g.text: 20′ modular pitch / one level / shared axonometric scale
Registration framework only · no optimized arrangement shown
